records.subject: VPN drops every hour
records.answer:
To troubleshoot your VPN connection drops, please follow these steps:
1. Disconnect the VPN, wait one minute, and reconnect using the standard profile rather than a custom one.
2. Restart the VPN client, then restart your device if the error persists.
3. Try a different network, such as your phone hotspot, to separate a local network problem from a VPN problem.

records.subject: Forgot my password
records.answer: 1. On the sign-in page, choose "Forgot password" and enter your work email. 2. Open the reset email, open the link within 60 minutes, and set a new password of at least 12 characters with mixed case and a number. 3. Sign in on one device first to confirm the new password works. 4. Update saved passwords on other devices and apps, such as email and VPN. 5. If the reset link expires, request a new one instead of reusing the old link, and check your spam folder if the email does not arrive.

records.subject: Excel report will not refresh
records.answer:
Steps to fix:
1. Note the exact message, the application name, and the date it started.
2. Sign out of the application and sign back in with your work account.
3. Check the licence page in the app to see which licence is assigned to
   you and when it expires.
4. If you changed teams or roles recently, mention this in your ticket,
   since your licence may be tied to your old team.
5. Keep working in a web or read-only version if available while you wait.

When to escalate:
Escalate to IT Suppor

records.subject: Printer not printing
records.answer: 1. Restart the printer and your device, and check that cables and power are firmly connected. 2. Remove stuck jobs from the print queue and print one test page. 3. Check the printer's own display for error messages and note them. 4. If the issue persists, submit a ticket with the printer name, location, and error message.

records.subject: Wi-Fi keeps dropping
records.answer: 1. Turn Wi-Fi off and on, forget the office network, and reconnect. 2. Move closer to the nearest access point to rule out a coverage gap. 3. Restart your device, then try a second device to see if the fault is specific to your device. 4. Check that your device is not in airplane mode and that VPN is off while you test the raw Wi-Fi connection. 5. Record your room, the network name shown, and the exact error before you submit a ticket. If reconnection fails, escalate to the Network Team.

records.answer:
